basis.value_representation: Unmodified DuckDB CAST AS VARCHAR; SQL NULL is JSON null. Keys use the unchanged historical L0 normalization.

edits.old: md5(concat_ws('|', coalesce(CAST(visitor_id AS VARCHAR), ''), coalesce(CAST(timestamp AS VARCHAR), ''), coalesce(CAST(poll_id AS VARCHAR), ''), coalesce(CAST(account_id AS VARCHAR), ''))) AS poll_event_key
edits.new: MD5(CONCAT(COALESCE(CAST(visitor_id AS TEXT), ''), COALESCE(CAST(timestamp AS TEXT), ''), COALESCE(CAST(account_id AS TEXT), ''), COALESCE(server_name, ''), COALESCE(CAST(poll_id AS TEXT), ''), COALESCE(CAST(guide_id AS TEXT), ''), COALESCE(user_agent, ''), COALESCE(remote_ip, ''))) AS poll_event_key

edits.old: CASE WHEN url IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(url AS VARCHAR)), '') END AS url
edits.new: CASE WHEN TRIM(url) = '' THEN NULL WHEN NOT url IS NULL AND REGEXP_FULL_MATCH(url, '^https?://') THEN TRIM(url) ELSE NULL END AS url
